story.title: Zakib: The Great Singer
paragraphs_en: Zakib was a really good singer. He had won several medals in school for her good voice. He was regarded as the best singer in the whole school. One day as Zakib was practicing for the annual function, her Music teacher came with a brilliant idea in her mind. She told Zakib," Zakib, why don't you go for an audition in a reality singing show. I think your voice is perfect and you have

the capability to get selected. Zakib first refused to go as his parents wouldn't permit him to go. But after he confirmed from his parents that he could go, he called his Music teacher and asked him what time to set out for the auditions. He was surprised when he heard that he was going for auditions of 'Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Little Champs'. Next day, they reached the set at 9:00 a.m.

Zakib went to the counter were contestant nameplates were being sold. He was very happy when he saw that his number was 18. He saw many contestants there.Out of the 16 who have already given their performance, only 5 were selected. The next contestant was a lucky one. He got selected on the basis of his beatboxing. His overall performance was rubbish. Now it was

Zakib, contestant no. 18's performance. His nervousness was on its top height. He went on the stage. There were three most popular judges. Zakib's performance started. Mrs. Lata Mangeshkar wasn't satisfied. When it came to Mrs. Asha Bhonsle, she was also not agreed. But, Mr. Mohammad Rafi was very much convinced by him . But the final result was that Zakib was

not satisfied. When the auditions were over, Mohammad Rafi came to him and said,"don't worry my child, I will make you a good singer." He took Zakib to his house and taught him everyday the best he could. Zakib went on to win 5 reality shows. He also sang songs in many films. one day, his assistant informed him that he has been invited on 'Sa Re Ga Ma Pa' as a celebrity guest of
honor. Zakib thought of his days when he got rejected from the 'Sa Re Ga Ma Pa' auditions. It was because of Sir Mohammad Rafi that he became an outstanding singer.
